items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...it was a Mingus tune... had all that stuff from Charlie Parker in the beginning...

ctx.x: And then Clark did a song called Clark in the Dark. Wah, he used the mute, wah, it was a Mingus tune, it was a killer, yeah I think that was probably it. Yeah, and then also, Mingus yeah, I remember Reincarnation of a Lovebird had all that stuff from Charlie Parker in the beginning and then it would come into the tune.
